notes.en:
Herdline 0.6.89 (Experimental, 10141)

- Chat now has a compact footer with the last recorded assistant reply's model/provider, the pane's last reported directory, and its per-reply USD cost estimate where available. Tap for full values, token counts and provenance. Missing metadata is omitted rather than borrowed from an earlier reply. Costs are not presented as session totals.
- Inline code has a distinct theme-aware tint and subtle chip outline. Explicitly labelled code fences now have syntax colors for shell, JSON, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Kotlin/Java, Rust, YAML, TOML and diff. Unknown or unlabelled languages remain plain. Copy preserves the original code.
- Optional recorded model/provider fields are read from OMP, Pi and Claude assistant messages without extra host reads. Other transcript readers omit unavailable metadata.

Verification: 184 native transcript tests, focused Kotlin footer/syntax/contrast/layout checks and the metadata regression passed. On an isolated Android 17 emulator, light/dark, narrow 320dp and font-scale fixtures were viewed; exact code Copy, missing-data hiding and Details passed. Real Chat with stock OMP resumed sample transcripts verified the footer and that older metadata is not reused. The portrait keyboard-up row was not dense mode; dense placement was checked in the visual fixture only. No LLM calls in runtime verification. Final signed APK runtime and Samsung rendering were not separately tested.
